name: support-rollback-planning
description: Plan post-launch support model + rollback strategy. Support: tiers (L1/L2/L3) + coverage + on-call rotation + escalation + SLAs per severity + hypercare window + runbook coverage. Rollback: strategy (feature flag off / deploy previous artifact / data roll-back / progressive-delivery abort), rollback triggers (SLO burn / error spike / manual kill-switch), rehearsal, communication during rollback, post-rollback action. Distinct from disaster-recovery-planning (infrastructure DR) and system-error-handling-strategy (runtime errors).
